name: Clinton County, OH
findings: Clinton County has 169 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clinton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Clinton County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.
